title: Skin tone and colors (analyze_skin_tone) arguments
description: Run YouCam AI Facial Color Tones analysis on the client's photo: skin tone and eye, lip, brow and hair colors as exact #RRGGBB values, useful for foundation and lipstick shade matching. Results appear on the client's Face screen. Costs 20 units. Hair color drifts under warm light, so prefer the other colors.

photo_id.description: A specific shared photo. Omit to use the latest photo.
